children: McDonald's announced McDonald’s > NEXT with targets for low-to-mid 50% operating margin by 2030 and ~250 bps restaurant efficiency gains.
Announces McDonald’s > NEXT to drive growth and productivity, supported by multi-year Make It Golden customer experience program.
Targets low-to-mid 50% operating margin by 2030, with G&A ~1.9% of Systemwide sales by 2030.
Plans ~250 basis points of gross restaurant-level efficiency gains tied to Restaurant > NEXT deployment.
Sets category share goals: +1.5pp in chicken and +1.5pp in beverage by 2030; maintain beef leadership.
Will provide ~ $8.5bn in total NEXT partnering support through 2036, including ~$5bn through 2030, and expects ~4-year payback for franchisees.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: McDonald's unveils NEXT strategy with targets for margin expansion, 250bps restaurant efficiency, and category share gains
